accepted_candidates.author: packet-author-a
accepted_candidates.findings: Inspected the actual bytes via inspect_candidate (SHA256 293175c4a4ced67cf149e976bf6a42d56d66b34bccf16c63597ae53d5c616df6), matching the packet content hash. The image is a stylized 3D-rendered family kitchen in 16:9 landscape aspect, warm daylight through a curtained window over the sink. Criteria assessment: (1) Empty stylized 3D family kitchen background — confirmed; soft-shaded CG render aesthetic, no live-action photo plate. (2) Usable 16:9 landscape — confirmed; wide horizontal framing. (3) Believable counter/sink/stove placement — confirmed; apron-front farmhouse sink centered under the window with tile backsplash, L-shaped sage cabinets with wood countertops continuing into the right corner, freestanding cream range with kettle on the cooktop and stand mixer on the right counter; plumbing underside cabinet and stove vent presence read plausibly. (4) Clear central floor space for character staging — confirmed; a large unobstructed wood floor area with only a small oval woven rug occupies the lower-center/left, leaving the mid-frame foreground clear. (5) No people, animals, human figures or faces — confirmed; all decorative items (plant pot, fruit bowl, mugs, fabrics) are non-figurative and no pareidolic faces appear in tiles, wood grain, curtains, or foliage. (6) No captions, logos or watermarks — confirmed; no text or branding anywhere in the frame. (7) Invented test scene — consistent with a generic, non-identifiable domestic kitchen rather than a specific memoir location. No blocking defects observed.

accepted_candidates.author: packet-author-b
accepted_candidates.findings: Reviewed the exact candidate in the packet (content_hash 0fa92275d57535fe889b8989978f739087e37426e4eeecc6f7854df035a4ec2e matches the SHA256 reported by inspect_candidate, and candidate_path /references/candidate.webp matches the packet's phase5 / packet-author-b assignment). The frame is a single landscape 16:9 image of a stylized 3D family kitchen rendered at dusk: warm interior lighting, white subway-tile backsplash, wood counters and upper cabinets, two green shaker lower-cabinet runs, a white retro refrigerator on the right, a farmhouse apron sink centered under a three-column window, a copper kettle on a range/stove at left, a small island with two X-back stools, hanging pendant lanterns, a mug rack and apple bowl on the right, and a woven rug on the floor. Assessment against the packet criteria: (1) EMPTY — the scene contains no occupants; the floor, counters, and staging zones are unoccupied. (2) 16:9 LANDSCAPE — the frame is a wide landscape composition with the proportions consistent with 16:9. (3) BELIEVABLE COUNTER/SINK/STOVE PLACEMENT — the stove/range sits against the left wall under the hood/cabinet zone, the sink is centered on the window wall with a gooseneck faucet on the counter behind it, and the wood counters wrap the walls at one consistent working height with the island at bar height facing the window; cabinetry, fridge, and shelving occupy plausible positions along the perimeter. (4) CLEAR CENTRAL FLOOR — the foreground/central floor area is open and unobstructed enough for character staging (only a flat rug lies on it, which does not block placement). (5) NO PEOPLE/ANIMALS/FIGURES/FACES — scanning the whole frame, including backsplash tiles, window/dusk reflection, appliance surfaces, hanging mugs, pots, and shelf items, I found no humans, animals, or face-like forms. (6) NO CAPTIONS/LOGOS/WATERMARKS — no text, logos, or watermarks appear anywhere in the frame. (7) INVENTED TEST SCENE — the composition is a generic, non-identifiable kitchen, not a recognizable memoir location. No blocking defects were found; only minor cosmetic notes are recorded.
